pr.title: feat(medusa,js-sdk,types): add POST /admin/payment-collections/:id/payment-sessions
pr.body:
## Summary                                                

  **What** — Adds `POST /admin/payment-collections/:id/payment-sessions` to the admin API, including  
  the route handler, Zod validator, middleware registration, TypeScript type, and JS SDK method.
                                                                                                      
  **Why** — The admin API did not support setting payment providers when creating payment collections.
   The store API already exposes this endpoint (`/store/payment-collections/:id/payment-sessions`),
  but the admin API was missing it, preventing merchants from initializing payment sessions with a    
  specific provider from the admin context.                 

  **How** — Mirrors the existing store implementation. The only intentional difference is that        
  `customer_id` is omitted (not relevant in an admin context). Uses the existing
  `createPaymentSessionsWorkflow` and `refetchEntity` utilities.                                      
                                                            
  **Testing** — Integration test added in                                                             
  `integration-tests/http/__tests__/payment-collection/admin/payment-sessions.spec.ts` using
  `createOrderSeeder` to set up a real order, creating an admin payment collection, and asserting the 
  session is created with `status: "pending"`.              

  ---

  ## Examples

  ```ts
  sdk.admin.paymentCollection.createPaymentSession("paycol_123", {
    provider_id: "pp_stripe_stripe"                                                                   
  })
  .then(({ payment_collection }) => {                                                                 
    console.log(payment_collection)                         
  })

  ---
  Checklist
           
  - I have added a changeset for this PR
  - The changes are covered by relevant tests                                                         
  - I have verified the code works as intended locally
  - I have linked the related issue(s) if applicable                                                  
                                                            
  ---
  Additional Context

  Closes #14621

<!-- CURSOR_SUMMARY -->
---

> [!NOTE]
> **Medium Risk**
> Adds a new admin endpoint that initializes payment sessions for payment collections, touching payment-flow API surface area. While it reuses existing workflows/validation, mistakes could affect how payments are initialized from the admin context.
> 
> **Overview**
> Adds `POST /admin/payment-collections/:id/payment-sessions`, allowing admins to initialize a payment session for an existing payment collection with a selected `provider_id` (and optional provider `data`).
> 
> Wires the route through new Zod validation + middleware policy checks, returns the refetched payment collection, exposes the call via a new JS SDK method (`paymentCollection.createPaymentSession`), and adds an integration test covering session creation through the admin API (plus a changeset/type additions).
> 
> <sup>Reviewed by [Cursor Bugbot](https://cursor.com/bugbot) for commit 4edfc0f6e8c756219a479215a6349c08c3f40aa1. Bugbot is set up for automated code reviews on this repo. Configure [here](https://www.cursor.com/dashboard/bugbot).</sup>
<!-- /CURSOR_SUMMARY -->

fix(payment-sessions): update endpoint path and improve validation structure

- Changed the endpoint path in the payment sessions test from `/admin/payment-collections/:id/payment-sessions` to `/store/payment-collections/:id/payment-sessions`.
- Refactored the `AdminInitializePaymentSession` validator to use `z.strictObject` for improved validation.
- Updated the route handler to use `req.validatedBody` instead of `req.body` for better request validation handling.

+import { createPaymentSessionsWorkflow } from "@medusajs/core-flows"
+import { HttpTypes } from "@medusajs/framework/types"
+import {
+  AuthenticatedMedusaRequest,
+  MedusaResponse,
+  refetchEntity,
+} from "@medusajs/framework/http"
+
+export const POST = async (
+  req: AuthenticatedMedusaRequest<
+    HttpTypes.AdminInitializePaymentSession,
+    HttpTypes.AdminGetPaymentCollectionParams
+  >,
+  res: MedusaResponse<HttpTypes.AdminPaymentCollectionResponse>
+) => {
+  const { id } = req.params
+  const { provider_id, data } = req.validatedBody
+
+  await createPaymentSessionsWorkflow(req.scope).run({
+    input: {
+      payment_collection_id: id,
+      provider_id,
+      data,
+    },
+  })
+
+  const paymentCollection = await refetchEntity({
+    entity: "payment_collection",
+    idOrFilter: id,
+    scope: req.scope,
+    fields: req.queryConfig.fields,
+  })
+
+  res.status(200).json({ payment_collection: paymentCollection })
+}
